verdict.rationale: Visa's first-party MCP server and agent toolkit are claimed to let developers and non-technical users work with AI agents in plain language, with no coding required. The MCP server also connects to Visa Intelligent Commerce APIs, and the npm package resolves live. However, natural-language operation is mediated by an external AI agent, and the documented toolkit tools focus on Pay by Link and Invoicing rather than the core Intelligent Commerce flows. missing for 10: documented natural-language coverage of core Intelligent Commerce operations (enrollment, purchase intents, credential retrieval), a native natural-language interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the plain-language claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: the toolkit helps developers and non-technical users to work with AI agents using plain language — no coding required.
Developers can now connect to Visa Intelligent Commerce APIs through the MCP Server
The specialized tools in the toolkit are designed to enable your AI agents to utilize the Pay by Link and Invoicing APIs.
